decisions.decision: Optimistic UI uses React useOptimistic, not TanStack Query's optimistic-updates guide
decisions.rationale: The board arrives as RSC props and ADR tech/0019 keeps reads out of the query cache, so setQueryData has nothing to write to. Applied to BOTH the task-move and column-reorder overrides.

decisions.decision: The add-task context bridge is KEPT, not deleted
decisions.rationale: BoardView publishes renderedColumns - the optimistic tail of the rename/reorder/move chain - not the server's columns. A server-side feed would show a renamed column's OLD name in the Add Task Status list until refresh landed. The header also sits above the [boardId] segment and context does not flow upward. Renamed for clarity instead.
